troubleshoot-an-http-404-error.title: Troubleshoot an HTTP 404 error
prechecks: Verify the URL is entered correctly (typo, case sensitivity).
Check if the resource/page has been moved or renamed (confirm with the application owner).
Test the URL from a different browser/incognito and different user to determine scope.
troubleshoot-an-http-404-error.rollback: If the page was mistakenly moved or deleted, restore it from backup or revert the web.config redirect rule.
troubleshoot-an-http-404-error.symptom_match: "Application is not accessible", "Web page not found".
troubleshoot-an-http-404-error.duplication: Unique. Keep distinct from 403 (#30 in B-4) and 500 (#2 in B-5).

troubleshoot-an-http-500-error.title: Troubleshoot an HTTP 500 error
prechecks: Step 0: check the application/platform provider health and active service incidents before changing the application or server.
Review application/web-server logs for the exact request timestamp, correlation/request ID and stack trace or error detail.
Check database, cache, queue, identity and other backend dependencies plus recent deployment/configuration changes.
troubleshoot-an-http-500-error.rollback: Capture the current deployment/configuration and use the approved deployment platform to restore the last known-good application release/configuration if a confirmed recent change caused the 500 response.

troubleshoot-application-printing.title: Troubleshoot application printing
prechecks: Test printing from a different application (e.g., Notepad) to isolate application vs. OS/printer.
Verify the correct printer is selected and the application's page setup is correct.
Check the print server/queue for the specific job.
troubleshoot-application-printing.rollback: If an application update broke printing, roll back the application version or reinstall the print module.

troubleshoot-audio-or-microphone-on-maco.title: Troubleshoot audio or microphone on macOS
prechecks: Verify selected input/output device and volume/mute state in macOS Sound settings.
Check application microphone permission in Privacy & Security and test recording with a built-in supported app.
Test a known-good headset/microphone or alternate port/device to separate hardware from application configuration.
troubleshoot-audio-or-microphone-on-maco.rollback: Record audio/device/application settings before change. Restore prior approved configuration if an app/MDM change caused regression. Do not attempt unsupported macOS audio-driver rollback; use supported OS/vendor remediation.
troubleshoot-audio-or-microphone-on-maco.symptom_match: "Apple macOS device is not working correctly", "Audio or microphone is not working".
troubleshoot-audio-or-microphone-on-maco.duplication: **Duplicate of Batch B-4 #27 (external display on macOS) in terms of category, but for audio.** Keep distinct for audio-specific steps.
troubleshoot-audio-or-microphone-on-maco.final_verdict: Needs rewrite and immediate P3 reclassification.

troubleshoot-blocked-browser-downloads.title: Troubleshoot blocked browser downloads
prechecks: Determine whether the block is from browser reputation protection, endpoint security/DLP, web filtering, a managed browser policy or a site/application restriction.
Verify the requested file type/source and whether corporate policy permits the download.
Test an approved alternative browser or known-safe test file only to isolate browser-specific behaviour; do not bypass mandatory security controls.
troubleshoot-blocked-browser-downloads.rollback: If an authorised browser/policy change causes wider failure, restore the previous approved policy. If security tooling quarantined or blocked the file, do not release it automatically; route it through the organisation's false-positive/security review process.
troubleshoot-blocked-browser-downloads.symptom_match: "Application is not accessible", "File cannot be downloaded".

troubleshoot-bluetooth-devices.title: Troubleshoot Bluetooth devices
prechecks: Verify Bluetooth is turned on in Windows/macOS settings.
Check Device Manager for Bluetooth driver errors.
Put the Bluetooth device in pairing mode and try re-pairing.
troubleshoot-bluetooth-devices.rollback: If a driver update broke Bluetooth, roll back the driver via Device Manager.
troubleshoot-bluetooth-devices.symptom_match: "Windows device is not working correctly", "Peripheral is not working".
troubleshoot-bluetooth-devices.final_verdict: Needs rewrite and immediate P3 reclassification.

troubleshoot-calendar-permissions.title: Troubleshoot calendar permissions
prechecks: Verify the user has the correct permissions on the target calendar (Reviewer, Author, Editor).
Check if the calendar is published or shared via Exchange Admin Center or Google Workspace Admin.
Test access from Outlook on the web to isolate client-side issues.
troubleshoot-calendar-permissions.rollback: If a permission change broke access, revert the permissions immediately via the admin console.
troubleshoot-calendar-permissions.symptom_match: "Access is denied or missing", "Exchange/M365 feature is not working".

troubleshoot-camera-access-on-macos.title: Troubleshoot camera access on macOS
prechecks: Check camera permission for the affected application in macOS Privacy & Security.
Test the camera in a built-in supported application to separate hardware from application-specific failure.
Check physical obstruction/cover and whether another application has exclusive camera use.
troubleshoot-camera-access-on-macos.rollback: Record permission/application/MDM state before change. Restore the previous approved configuration if a managed-policy change caused regression. Do not attempt unsupported camera-driver rollback through Recovery.
troubleshoot-camera-access-on-macos.symptom_match: "Apple macOS device is not working correctly", "Video/Camera is not working".
troubleshoot-camera-access-on-macos.duplication: **Duplicate of Batch B-4 #16 (webcam on Windows) but for macOS.** This is also related to Batch B-2 #23 (Teams camera). Keep as a macOS-specific branch.
troubleshoot-camera-access-on-macos.final_verdict: Needs rewrite and immediate P3 reclassification.

troubleshoot-chrome-profile-synchronisat.title: Troubleshoot Chrome profile synchronisation
prechecks: Confirm the user is signed into the intended managed Chrome profile and determine which sync data types are failing.
Check managed Chrome/Google policies and whether sync is paused, disabled or restricted.
Preserve/export user-recoverable bookmarks or other approved local data before any profile reset or cloud-sync reset.
troubleshoot-chrome-profile-synchronisat.rollback: Restore the previous approved managed policy/profile configuration if a change caused the failure. Do not clear cloud sync data unless the source of truth and recovery path are confirmed.
troubleshoot-chrome-profile-synchronisat.symptom_match: "Cannot sign in", "Browser is not working correctly".

troubleshoot-citrix-audio-or-microphone.title: Troubleshoot Citrix audio or microphone
prechecks: Confirm the local microphone/audio device works outside Citrix before changing the VDI.
Check Citrix session/VDA health plus applicable HDX audio or real-time media optimisation components where deployed.
Review Citrix policy for audio redirection, device mapping and bandwidth/quality limits.
troubleshoot-citrix-audio-or-microphone.rollback: Record VDA/master-image and Citrix policy versions before change. If an approved VDA/media component or policy change causes regression, restore the previous approved image/component/policy through the Citrix change process.
troubleshoot-citrix-audio-or-microphone.symptom_match: "VDI session is not working", "Audio or microphone is not working".
troubleshoot-citrix-audio-or-microphone.duplication: Related to #4 (macOS audio) but Citrix-specific. Keep distinct.

troubleshoot-citrix-printing.title: Troubleshoot Citrix printing
prechecks: Confirm the client printer works locally and determine whether it is mapped into the Citrix session.
Check VDA Print Spooler, Citrix printing policies and Universal Print Driver/driver mapping where used.
Check Citrix Workspace/VDA version compatibility and whether the issue affects one session, one host or the whole delivery group.
troubleshoot-citrix-printing.rollback: Capture Citrix printing policy/master-image driver state before change. Restore the previous approved driver/image/policy if a confirmed update causes regression.
troubleshoot-citrix-printing.symptom_match: "Printing or scanning is not working", "VDI session is not working".

troubleshoot-colour-or-duplex-printing.title: Troubleshoot colour or duplex printing
prechecks: Verify the printer driver supports colour/duplex (check the device capabilities).
Check the application's page setup and printer preferences.
Test from a different application to isolate driver vs. application settings.
troubleshoot-colour-or-duplex-printing.rollback: If a driver update broke colour/duplex, roll back to the previous driver via Print Management.
troubleshoot-colour-or-duplex-printing.duplication: Related to "application printing" (#3) but specific to hardware capabilities. Keep distinct as a child branch.

troubleshoot-conference-room-audio.title: Troubleshoot conference-room audio
prechecks: Check room-system service/device health, physical USB/HDMI/audio connections and selected input/output devices.
Test local playback/recording separately from an online meeting to isolate room hardware from platform/network media.
Check room audio DSP/soundbar/microphone firmware and recent configuration changes.
troubleshoot-conference-room-audio.rollback: Record room-device configuration and firmware before change. Revert firmware only where the vendor supports rollback; otherwise restore the previous approved configuration or route to vendor support.
troubleshoot-conference-room-audio.symptom_match: "Meeting room system is not working", "Audio or microphone is not working".
troubleshoot-conference-room-audio.duplication: Related to Batch B-2 #2 (Teams Room offline) – #2 is system-level, #13 is audio-specific. Keep distinct.

troubleshoot-directory-synchronisation.title: Troubleshoot directory synchronisation
prechecks: Step 0: check Microsoft Entra Connect/Cloud Sync health and active service incidents before changing synchronization configuration.
Review Sync Service Manager / connector run history and exact import, synchronization or export errors for the incident window.
Check connectivity to on-premises directory and Entra endpoints, connector credentials/permissions and object conflicts such as duplicate UPN/proxy addresses or immutable-identity mismatches.
troubleshoot-directory-synchronisation.rollback: Export/capture synchronization rules and connector configuration before change. If an approved sync-rule/configuration change caused failures, restore the previous known-good configuration. Do not stop or replace a full synchronization solely because it is slow; stop only when an authorised operator confirms it is erroneous and understands the object-impact risk.
troubleshoot-directory-synchronisation.symptom_match: "Cannot sign in", "Microsoft 365 feature is not working", "Access is denied or missing".

troubleshoot-disk-encryption-compliance.title: Troubleshoot disk-encryption compliance
prechecks: Check the authoritative MDM/endpoint-management encryption state and confirm recovery-key escrow is healthy before changing BitLocker/FileVault protection.
Check TPM/Secure Enclave/secure-chip state, relevant firmware/security settings and current protectors.
Check for an authorised pending suspend/resume operation and identify why the device is reported non-compliant.
troubleshoot-disk-encryption-compliance.rollback: Do not decrypt the device as routine remediation. If encryption was intentionally suspended for an authorised maintenance action, resume protection after verification. If a policy change causes incorrect compliance reporting, restore the previous approved policy while preserving encryption and recovery escrow.
troubleshoot-disk-encryption-compliance.symptom_match: "A security or compliance concern is reported".

troubleshoot-docker-desktop.title: Troubleshoot Docker Desktop
prechecks: Check Docker Desktop service status and virtualization (WSL2/Hyper-V) health.
Verify disk space and memory allocation for Docker images/containers.
Check Docker daemon logs for specific errors.
troubleshoot-docker-desktop.rollback: If a Docker Desktop update broke functionality, roll back to the previous version via the Docker installer.
troubleshoot-docker-desktop.symptom_match: "Developer environment is not working", "Application is not accessible".

troubleshoot-endpoint-protection-health.title: Troubleshoot endpoint protection health
prechecks: Step 0: check the EDR/AV management console for device health, last check-in, sensor/service state and active alerts.
Verify real-time protection, tamper protection, engine/definition/sensor version and management connectivity.

Determine whether this is a health/configuration issue or an active security alert; active threat evidence must route to the incident/EDR-alert runbook rather than being treated as routine agent repair.
troubleshoot-endpoint-protection-health.rollback: Record the current approved endpoint-protection policy/sensor version before change. Restore the previous approved policy or vendor-supported sensor version if a confirmed update causes regression. Do not disable protection as a troubleshooting shortcut.
troubleshoot-endpoint-protection-health.symptom_match: "A security or compliance concern is reported".
troubleshoot-endpoint-protection-health.duplication: Related to Batch B-3 #10 (EDR alert investigation) – #10 is reactive, #17 is proactive health checks. Keep distinct.

troubleshoot-gmail-delegation.title: Troubleshoot Gmail delegation
prechecks: Check Google Workspace Admin console for delegated user permissions.
Verify the delegate has been granted the correct access level (Send As, Read, Manage).
Test access from the Gmail web interface.
troubleshoot-gmail-delegation.rollback: If a delegation change broke access, revert the permission immediately via the Google Admin console.
troubleshoot-gmail-delegation.symptom_match: "Access is denied or missing", "Google Workspace feature is not working".

troubleshoot-gmail-send-or-receive.title: Troubleshoot Gmail send or receive
prechecks: Step 0: check Google Workspace Status Dashboard/admin service alerts before changing Gmail routing or client settings.
Determine whether the issue affects one user, domain/OU/group or all mail flow; capture message IDs, timestamps and bounce/error details.
Check mailbox/storage state, sending limits, routing/compliance rules and attachment/message limits relevant to the failure.
troubleshoot-gmail-send-or-receive.rollback: Export/capture the affected routing/compliance policy before change. If an authorised policy change caused mail-flow failure, restore the previous approved policy and verify controlled test messages.
troubleshoot-gmail-send-or-receive.symptom_match: "Email is not being delivered", "Google Workspace feature is not working".
troubleshoot-gmail-send-or-receive.duplication: Related to Google Workspace suite. Keep distinct.

troubleshoot-google-drive-synchronisatio.title: Troubleshoot Google Drive synchronisation
prechecks: Check Google Drive for desktop status/errors and verify the user can access the same files in the web interface.
Check network connectivity, local disk space and managed Drive configuration.
Identify conflicts, offline state or local/cloud version differences and establish the authoritative copy before reset or relink.
troubleshoot-google-drive-synchronisatio.rollback: Preserve local unsynchronised data before client repair. If a managed Drive client rollout causes regression, restore the previous approved managed package/version where supported; do not overwrite cloud data to force a sync.

troubleshoot-google-meet-audio-or-video.title: Troubleshoot Google Meet audio or video
prechecks: Check Google Workspace/Meet service health before local client remediation.
Test camera/microphone outside the browser and verify browser/site permissions plus selected devices.
Check network quality and media reachability using approved diagnostics rather than relying only on a generic speed test.
troubleshoot-google-meet-audio-or-video.rollback: Restore previous approved browser/managed policy/device configuration if a change caused regression. Avoid downgrading to an unsupported browser version; use a supported alternate client/browser while the regression is remediated.
troubleshoot-google-meet-audio-or-video.symptom_match: "Google Workspace feature is not working", "Video/Camera is not working".

troubleshoot-high-cpu-utilisation.title: Troubleshoot high CPU utilisation
prechecks: Determine whether the high CPU is a single endpoint or service/server-wide condition and identify the top processes with Task Manager/Performance Monitor or approved tooling.
Correlate process/service errors, recent deployments/updates and scheduled activity with the high-CPU window.
Check whether the process is legitimate expected load, a runaway workload or potentially malicious before terminating it.
troubleshoot-high-cpu-utilisation.rollback: Capture process/service and recent-change state. If a confirmed deployment/update caused the load, restore the previous approved version/configuration. Restart or stop a service only under change authority and after checking dependencies.
troubleshoot-high-cpu-utilisation.symptom_match: "Windows device is not working correctly", "Application is slow or unresponsive".
troubleshoot-high-cpu-utilisation.duplication: Related to #24 (High memory) – keep separate as root causes differ.

troubleshoot-high-load-on-linux.title: Troubleshoot high load on Linux
prechecks: Use `uptime`, `top`/`ps` and load averages to establish scope and identify consuming/runnable processes.
Use approved tools such as `vmstat`, `iostat` and filesystem/network checks to separate CPU, memory, I/O wait and blocked-task pressure.
Check recent deployments/jobs and unexpected connection/process patterns; route suspected attack activity to Security Operations.
troubleshoot-high-load-on-linux.rollback: Capture service/deployment state before changes. Restore a confirmed bad deployment/configuration through the approved release process. Restart a leaking/runaway service only after dependencies and business impact are understood.
troubleshoot-high-load-on-linux.symptom_match: "Application is slow or unresponsive", "Linux device is not working correctly".

troubleshoot-high-memory-utilisation.title: Troubleshoot high memory utilisation
prechecks: Determine endpoint versus server/service-wide scope and identify top processes, working set/private memory and commit/pagefile pressure.
Check for sustained growth/leak patterns, recent deployments and application/service errors.
Check available memory, paging/swap behaviour and whether memory pressure is causing process termination or service degradation.
troubleshoot-high-memory-utilisation.rollback: If a confirmed recent deployment/configuration caused the leak, restore the previous approved release/configuration. Restart affected services only under change authority and after checking dependencies and preserving diagnostic evidence.
troubleshoot-high-memory-utilisation.symptom_match: "Application is slow or unresponsive", "Application is not accessible".

troubleshoot-known-folder-move.title: Troubleshoot Known Folder Move
prechecks: Check OneDrive client/Known Folder Move status and exact error plus whether Desktop/Documents/Pictures data is available locally, in OneDrive web or both.
Check OneDrive storage/quota, sync health, managed KFM policy and conflicting folder redirection.
Establish the authoritative copy and preserve unsynchronised local data before changing KFM, unlinking OneDrive or moving folders.
troubleshoot-known-folder-move.rollback: Do not blindly stop sync and move folders. If an approved KFM policy change caused regression, restore the previous managed policy and reconcile local/cloud data only after the source of truth is confirmed.
troubleshoot-known-folder-move.symptom_match: "Microsoft 365 feature is not working", "OneDrive sync is failing".

troubleshoot-linux-certificate-trust.title: Troubleshoot Linux certificate trust
prechecks: Check system time/NTP state and the active CA trust store for the distribution/application.
Use `openssl s_client` or the application's supported TLS diagnostics to inspect the presented chain, hostname and verification errors.
Check whether the affected service uses the system trust store, a Java/application-specific trust store or a container/image-specific store.
troubleshoot-linux-certificate-trust.rollback: Back up trust-store/certificate configuration before change. If an authorised trust/certificate update causes regression, restore the previous approved CA/certificate bundle and restart/reload only the affected service as required.
troubleshoot-linux-certificate-trust.symptom_match: "Cannot sign in", "A security or compliance concern is reported".

troubleshoot-linux-sign-in.title: Troubleshoot Linux sign-in
prechecks: Determine local-console versus SSH versus directory/SSO login scope and verify the account is not locked/expired.
Review SSH/authentication logs for the exact attempt and check authorized keys/home-directory ownership/permissions as relevant.
Check PAM/SSSD/LDAP/Kerberos or other configured identity-provider health before changing authentication files.
troubleshoot-linux-sign-in.rollback: Back up PAM/SSSD/SSH authentication configuration before change. Restore the previous approved configuration if a confirmed edit causes lockout; keep an authorised recovery session/console path available before remote authentication changes.
troubleshoot-linux-sign-in.symptom_match: "Cannot sign in", "Linux device is not working correctly".

troubleshoot-macos-sign-in-failure.title: Troubleshoot macOS sign-in failure
prechecks: Verify the exact account type and identity source, account/password state and whether FileVault preboot login is involved.
Check local account/home-directory ownership and relevant authentication/MDM logs.
Check whether Keychain symptoms occur after login rather than assuming Keychain corruption is the cause of the login failure.
troubleshoot-macos-sign-in-failure.rollback: Do not use password reset or OS rollback as a generic first response. Preserve FileVault/recovery access and user data; if an approved account/MDM configuration change caused the issue, restore that configuration. Password recovery must follow identity-verification and organisational recovery procedures.
troubleshoot-macos-sign-in-failure.symptom_match: "Apple macOS device is not working correctly", "Cannot sign in".

troubleshoot-meeting-updates-or-cancella.title: Troubleshoot meeting updates or cancellations
prechecks: Check the applicable Microsoft 365/Exchange or Google Workspace service health before client-side remediation.
Confirm organizer identity/permissions and whether the issue affects one meeting, one user or multiple recipients.
Check transport/calendar processing rules, mailbox/calendar delegation and message trace/audit evidence for updates or cancellations.
troubleshoot-meeting-updates-or-cancella.rollback: Capture affected calendar/transport policy before change. If an authorised rule/policy change caused the issue, restore the previous approved configuration and verify with a controlled test meeting.
troubleshoot-meeting-updates-or-cancella.symptom_match: "Exchange/M365 feature is not working", "Google Workspace feature is not working".

troubleshoot-multiple-monitor-arrangemen.title: Troubleshoot multiple-monitor arrangement or resolution
prechecks: This compatibility page must route to the definitive external-monitor runbook established in Batch B-4.
Preserve the historical URL and symptom mapping while moving arrangement/resolution guidance into the canonical runbook.
troubleshoot-multiple-monitor-arrangemen.rollback: No independent remediation is permitted after deprecation; rollback and verification belong to the canonical external-monitor procedure.
troubleshoot-multiple-monitor-arrangemen.symptom_match: "Display is not working", "Windows device is not working correctly".
troubleshoot-multiple-monitor-arrangemen.duplication: **Duplicate of Batch B-4 #27, #28, #29.** Merge into one definitive "Troubleshoot an external monitor" P2 procedure. This is the generic version, but the specific "arrangement or resolution" branch can be a subset.
